categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in urban solid waste incineration power generation, kitchen waste harmless treatment, dead livestock harmless treatment, solid waste treatment and ash slag comprehensive utilization, energy-saving and environmental protection equipment, and electrical special equipment. It also engages in related construction and operation services under BOT, BOO, and BT models. The business structure includes waste treatment services, environmental protection equipment manufacturing, and electrical equipment manufacturing.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes mature domestic incineration technology with advanced and stable grate furnace combustion processes for waste treatment. It employs advanced environmental protection technologies for flue gas, leachate, slag, and fly ash treatment. The company also develops AI combustion optimization control systems for incinerators and focuses on low-nitrogen combustion technology to reduce emissions. In equipment manufacturing, it emphasizes modular design, intelligent control, and standardization, integrating digital and smart technologies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include local governments, state-owned power grid companies, industrial parks, and large group clients. The company serves urban solid waste management sectors, municipal and industrial wastewater treatment, and electrical equipment markets. Major customers are provincial power companies such as State Grid subsidiaries in Hebei, Anhui, Sichuan, Shandong, and Hebei North. The company also targets overseas markets along the Belt and Road initiative.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively across China, covering 16 provinces including key regions such as the Yangtze River Economic Belt, Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area, East China, South China, Central China, North China, Northwest, Southwest, and Northeast. It also exports products to over 50 countries including Italy, Russia, Saudi Arabia, UAE, Turkey, India, Thailand, Malaysia, and Vietnam.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the environmental protection industry supply chain. It invests in, constructs, and operates waste incineration power plants and environmental protection equipment manufacturing. It also provides integrated environmental services and manages related assets, positioning itself as a comprehensive service provider and equipment manufacturer within the waste treatment and energy sectors.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include advancing technology innovation to improve waste incineration efficiency, emission reduction, and resource utilization. The company emphasizes AI and digital transformation for intelligent operation and management. It focuses on developing small-scale incineration equipment, low-cost flue gas upgrading solutions, and high-value resource recovery technologies such as biogas hydrogen production. R&D efforts also target water and solid waste integrated treatment equipment and smart manufacturing solutions.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through waste treatment service fees, electricity sales from incineration power plants, equipment sales, and construction service contracts. The company operates under concession models (BOT, BOO, BT) with long-term operating periods (25-30 years) to recover investments and earn returns. Equipment sales include direct sales of environmental protection and electrical equipment, with revenue recognized upon delivery and customer acceptance.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading central enterprise in China's environmental protection sector, leveraging its state-owned platform and brand advantages. It holds a strong market position in waste incineration power generation and environmental equipment manufacturing, with significant presence in multiple provinces and international markets. Competitors include other large state-owned and private environmental service providers and equipment manufacturers, but the company benefits from its comprehensive service capabilities and technological innovation.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately 5.92 billion RMB, a slight decrease of 3.67% from the previous year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of about 605 million RMB, down 14.49%. Total assets stood at over 30.5 billion RMB, with net assets of approximately 13.5 billion RMB. The company maintains a stable growth trajectory with ongoing investments in technology and market expansion, despite some fluctuations in profitability.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its comprehensive waste treatment solutions integrating incineration, resource recovery, and environmental protection equipment manufacturing. It differentiates through advanced technology, including AI-driven combustion control, low-emission processes, and modular intelligent equipment. Leveraging its central enterprise status, extensive geographic coverage, and strong government partnerships, it offers reliable, efficient, and environmentally friendly services and products, supporting China's green and low-carbon development goals.
